title: rpt evidence record
description: One reference a finding or page makes to an evidence file, from its evidence list or a link in its text, as rpt evidence get emits it; with --orphans, also each file in findings/evidence/ or pages/evidence/ that nothing references, which has no owner, ref or source. rpt evidence add reads records with a file member: the file to add. Schema version 3.

finding.description: ID of the finding that makes the reference. A record has finding or page, not both.

page.description: ID of the page that makes the reference.

ref.description: The path as the owner writes it, relative to the owner's file.

source.description: frontmatter: the evidence list; body: an image or link in the text.

path.description: Relative to the report root. Absent when ref leaves the report.

file.description: Absolute path, symlinks not resolved; use it to open the file. Absent when ref leaves the report.

media_type.description: The file's media type, detected from its content, else from its extension, such as image/png. Absent when there is no file.

text.description: A link's text, or an image's alt text: its caption.

section.description: The key of the finding section the link is in.

line.description: The line of the owner's file the link starts on.

rev.description: The owner's revision; an evidence file's own bytes aren't tracked. Opaque: compare it, never compute it. Pass it back as --if-rev so a write is refused if the owner changed since this read.
